subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'TARGET' is written as 'UbShfU' and 'FLOW' is written as 'gMPX'. How will 'MACROS' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

**The pattern followed here is :**

 
• **(1) is added to position value of each letter.**
 
• **Single digit position value - code is written in small letters.**
 
• **Double digits position value - Code is written in capital letters.**&
